The '''electromagnetic duster''' was a cleaning tool created from the template of the [[Vibromop|Vibro-mop]], a type of mop invented<ref name="Codex" /> in [[3666 BBY]].<ref name="Date Note" /> The electromagnetic duster, along with the [[ion-charged dishrag]], were considered a part of a new and exciting array of cleaning apparatus derived from the Vibro-mop.<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
The electromagnetic duster was mentioned in the Codex entry "History of the Vibro-mop" in [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire|''Knights of the Fallen Empire'']], the [[2015]] expansion to the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', developed by [[BioWare]].<ref name="Codex" />
